problem_statement: Build a brand-new /certifications page from scratch on this SvelteKit portfolio site. The route /certifications does not exist yet (SvelteKit renders a native 404). Create src/routes/certifications/+page.svelte reusing the site's existing design system (CommonPage layout, MainTitle, Card, UIcon, the CSS custom-property palette --accent/--main-text/--tertiary-text/--border). The page lists professional certifications (each with name, issuer, category and year) as cards, and includes a category filter bar (All / Cloud / Security / Data) implemented as buttons. Clicking a filter shows only the certifications in that category and updates a live count line ('Showing N ... certifications'). The default view is 'All' showing every certification. The layout must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile (390px).
required_content: Page title heading 'Certifications' rendered via the site's MainTitle/CommonPage
An intro paragraph describing the certifications collection
A filter button bar with four buttons: All, Cloud, Security, Data (each carrying a unique data-filter attribute)
A live count paragraph 'Showing 7 certifications' in the default All state
A responsive grid of certification Cards, each showing the certification name (h3), issuer, category and year
At least one certification per category so filtering is observable (7 total: 3 Cloud, 2 Security, 2 Data)
Clicking the Cloud filter updates the count line to 'Showing 3 Cloud certifications' and shows only the 3 cloud cards
Mobile viewport (390px) stacks the grid single-column with no horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse CommonPage + MainTitle for the page shell and heading (site nav/header comes from +layout.svelte)
Reuse the Card and UIcon components and the CSS custom-property palette (--accent, --main-text, --tertiary-text, --border, --main-close, --accent-text)
Inline the certification data as a static const array in the page (no live API / network fetch)
Filter controls must be <button> elements with a unique data-filter attribute (select via button[data-filter="Cloud"], never by text)

Palette to match (from the site's CSS custom properties): active/selected filter pill uses the accent fill (approx rgb(193,193,193)) with dark text (rgb(0,0,0)); inactive filter pills are transparent with muted text (approx rgb(46,46,46)); the shared border color is approx rgb(225,225,225); card and heading text is near-black (rgb(0,0,0) / rgb(30,30,30)) on a white page background (rgb(255,255,255))

Filter buttons are rounded pill shapes (border-radius ~20px, 1px solid border, light font-weight ~300, letter-spacing wider, small ~0.9em text) laid out as a single horizontal bar directly under the title/intro

Certification cards are the site's Card component in a responsive grid (multi-column on desktop, single column stacked on mobile 390px), each card showing the certification name as an h3, then issuer, category and year lines

The intro paragraph should read like 'A curated set of professional certifications ...' and sit between the MainTitle and the filter bar; the live count line 'Showing 7 certifications' sits with the filter bar and updates to 'Showing N <Category> certifications' when a category filter is active
author_notes: Scheme A. baseline: no src/routes/certifications/ dir → SvelteKit native 404 (empty). reference: full page — CommonPage shell, intro, 4 filter buttons (data-filter), live count, 7 cert Cards, reactive filter. bad: identical to reference EXCEPT setFilter is a no-op so active category is frozen at 'All' → clicking Cloud does NOT change the count/cards → interaction_assertions fails while dom + no_horizontal_overflow still pass. adapter switched adapter-static→adapter-node in all 3 workspaces (adapter-auto/static basename+SSG-fallback traps offline); capture serves via vite dev (SSR, base='' in dev → plain /certifications). Three workspaces md5-distinct (driven by the +page.svelte file).

_build_meta.install: (corepack enable && corepack yarn install --frozen-lockfile) || npm install
